zh: 这双鞋对我的脚来说太窄了。
en: These shoes are too {narrow|tight} for my feet.

zh: 这件衬衫有点松，有小一号的吗？
en: This shirt is a bit {loose|baggy|big}; do you have a smaller size?

zh: 我想找一个价格更实惠的。
en: I'm looking for something more {affordable|reasonable}.

zh: 网上买便宜十块钱。
en: It's ten dollars {cheaper} online.

zh: 这个包是真皮的吗？
en: Is this bag {genuine|real} leather?

zh: 结果那块手表是假的。
en: The watch turned out to be {fake|counterfeit}.

zh: 我想要一个耐用的背包，能用很多年。
en: I want a {durable|sturdy|strong|solid} backpack that will last for years.

zh: 这双运动鞋穿着真的很舒服。
en: These trainers are really {comfortable|comfy}.

zh: 我在 Trade Me 上买了一辆二手自行车。
en: I bought a {second-hand|secondhand|used} bike on Trade Me.

zh: 它是全新的，我连盒子都没打开过。
en: It's {brand new|brand-new}; I've never even opened the box.

zh: 这个型号很受欢迎，我们一周能卖二十个左右。
en: This model is very {popular}; we sell about twenty a week.

zh: 请包仔细一点，这个东西易碎。
en: Please wrap it carefully; it's {fragile|delicate|breakable}.

zh: 我想要一件没有图案和标志的素色T恤。
en: I'd prefer a {plain} T-shirt with no logo or pattern.

zh: 包裹送到的时候盒子已经破损了。
en: The box was {damaged} when the parcel arrived.

zh: 这件夹克不适合大雨天穿。
en: This jacket isn't {suitable|good} for heavy rain.

zh: 机场里的东西定价都过高。
en: Everything at the airport is {overpriced|expensive|pricey|dear}.

zh: 我需要几件周末穿的休闲衣服。
en: I need some {casual} clothes to wear at the weekend.

zh: 面试你得穿得正式得体一点。
en: You'll need {smart|formal} clothes for the interview.

zh: 押金可以全额退还。
en: The deposit is fully {refundable}.

zh: 这个小包旅行时特别方便好用。
en: This little bag is really {handy|useful|convenient} for travelling.
